extracted.intended_audience: students and scholars of classical mechanics; mathematicians, physicists, and historians studying Newton's Principia
extracted.subtask_description: A sequence of propositions, lemmas, corollaries, and demonstrations from Newton's Principia (Book I) deriving the relationships between motion in curves (circles, ellipses, parabolas, hyperbolas, spirals) and the form of the centripetal force required (e.g., inverse-square, linear, cubic laws).
